senses.sense_definition: A spiritual leader of a Jewish congregation or community.

examples.text: The <w>rabbi</w> delivered an inspiring sermon at the synagogue this morning.

target_lang_translations.de: Der <w>Rabbiner</w> hielt heute Morgen eine inspirierende Predigt in der Synagoge.

examples.text: We asked our local <w>rabbi</w> for advice on how to prepare for the holiday.

target_lang_translations.zh: 我们向当地的<w>拉比</w>请教了如何为节日做准备。
